name: agentviva
description: Check whether an AI tool, agent or API is still alive, and set up monitoring that says so.

api_key.title: AgentViva API key
api_key.description: Optional. Your team key (av_live_...), from the API page at https://agentviva.dev/app/api. Without it you can still look up tools AgentViva already watches; with it you get all the tools.
